consumers.usage: Generates each stack's Gatus configuration from this package's gatus/base.yaml plus the endpoints its own port/origin resolver produced, and validates every component's /version and /healthz response against these schemas in its integration tests.
Its backend serves /version and /healthz in this shape, and /api/status carries the same version.
Serves /version and /healthz in this shape; /healthz additionally reports its own database readiness and the AUE image version its scheduler is configured with.
Serves /version and /healthz in this shape, with the instance field carrying its Colyseus instance id so two instances of one build are distinguishable.
Its static-serving binary answers /version and /healthz in this shape, and the built frontend shows the same version in its footer.
